title: Blue Man Group - A New Holiday Surprise on Broadway #bluemangroup #bl...
transcript: Why is the Blue Man Group Broadway holiday special low-key the hypest rave in New York City right now? In all seriousness, I have no idea what this was. I'd never seen the Blue Man Group before and I'm equally if not more confused by who they are and what they do after seeing this show. Do with that what you will, Merry Christmas.
showTitle: Blue Man Group "A New Holiday Surprise"
classificationReason: Creator attended the show and shares a first-hand opinion — confused and bewildered by the experience, with a tongue-in-cheek reaction ('Merry Christmas'). Counts as a review.
